name: GFL Environmental Inc.

listing.domicile: Canada (Ontario) - no re-domicile found in Q3-26 release

corporate_actions.event: Sale of Environmental Services business (valued $8.0bn) to Apollo/BC Partners; GFL retained equity-method stake (balance $1.85bn at 30-Sep-26)
Acquisition of SECURE Waste Infrastructure Corp. included in guidance; SECURE nominee joins board
Special Committee concluded review of unsolicited take-private proposals; board unanimously decided to remain public; sponsor shareholders' stakes may be sold

geography.fx_notes: Canada and 19 US states; SECURE acquisition raises Canadian weight (Canada revenue +38% in Q3). INFERENCE US ~60%, Canada ~40% - not >70% single country.

kpis.value: 3.8x at 30-Sep-26 (3.4x Dec-25); target mid-3s by YE26

kpis.value: PitchBook TTM EBITDA $1.21bn vs company adj. ~ $2.3-2.5bn - large adjustment gap

lease.source_id: not collected - IFRS filer, cash-flow statement lease lines needed

acquisitions.notes: SECURE Waste Infrastructure (price/consideration not in Q3 release; contributed ~C$150m revenue and ~C$50m EBITDA in first month per CFO); acquisitions added 18.7pt to Q3 growth

management.guidance_record: FY2026 guidance raised three times in 2026

ownership.controlling_holders: Founder Dovigi plus financial sponsor shareholders (BC Partners/others historically) - exact % not verified
ownership.board_independence: Special Committee of independent directors ran sale review (S2)
ownership.related_party: Retained equity stake in divested GFL Environmental Services and in Green Infrastructure Partners (prior spin) create related-party-like links; not quantified

evidence: Solid waste collection/disposal; price 5.7% vs volume -0.1% (S1)
A.rationale: Recurring solid waste, with SECURE adding energy-linked infrastructure.

evidence: Integrated landfill/transfer network across Canada & 19 states (S1)
B.rationale: Disposal assets give pricing power; density lower than top-3.

C.rationale: Scale reached but economics similar to peers.

D.rationale: Large M&A runway; returns on acquisitions not evidenced.

evidence: History of large debt-funded M&A and asset sales (S1)

H.rationale: Sponsor overhang and complex related structures.

evidence: Diesel impact on margin; SECURE adds oil & gas sensitivity (S1)
Reported net loss from continuing ops ($28m Q3) vs adj. EBITDA $679m (S1)

sector_specific.env_liabilities: Landfill closure/post-closure provisions (IFRS) not re-read; SECURE adds energy-infrastructure decommissioning/remediation liabilities - not quantified. PFAS risk at landfills.
sector_specific.commodity_sensitivity: Commodity +0.3% Q3; diesel; SECURE (energy waste infrastructure) adds oil & gas activity sensitivity.

gates.notes: G1 B: company net leverage 3.8x (just under 4.0x waste threshold) but provider ND/EBITDA ~7x and TTM EBIT ($105m) << cash interest (~$455m 2026E) -> interest cover <4x. G4 B: net income negative/volatile (discontinued-ops gains in 2025), FCF/NI not meaningful. G6 B: take-private proposals rejected 10-Nov-2026 but sponsor-stake sale process continuing; not an agreed takeover so not A. No re-domicile or US listing change found.

bull_points: Price-led organic growth 7.4% with underlying margin expansion.
Board rejected premium take-private bids as undervaluing standalone value - signals confidence.
SECURE adds scarce Western Canada disposal infrastructure.
bear_points: Leverage back up to 3.8x with weak interest cover on reported EBIT.
Reported losses and large adjustments - accounting quality below peers.
Transaction-driven strategy and sponsor overhang (stake sales).
thesis_breakers: Organic price <4% or adj. FCF < C$/US$1.0bn in 2027.
Another large debt-funded acquisition before leverage <3.5x.
